Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced and relied on a Britannica page view showing the incorrect death year (August 13, 1897), introducing the wrong date that contradicts multiple authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia, Find a Grave, later Britannica view, museum sources) which give August 13, 1896. This acceptance of an anomalous/erroneous page snapshot without reconciling against the broader evidence could directly lead to the incorrect final answer.
